The NEET-UG examination qualification serves as the primary criterion for admission to the Ayush Courses. Private and government Ayurveda, Unani, & Homeopathy institutions in Bihar recognized by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) and National Commission for Homeopathy (NCH) participate in the state counselling.

Bihar Ayush Counselling is conducted for admission to BAMS, BUMS & BHMS courses by the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) . The candidates should register themselves with the Bihar Ayush Counselling official website at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in/ for participating in the counselling. The NEET-UG examination conducted by NTA is the mandatory qualification required for applying to the UGMAC (Ayush). In order to participate in the counselling, NEET-qualified candidates must possess higher secondary education in the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects.

Bihar has 10 BAMS colleges , 15 BHMS colleges, and 5 BUMS colleges participating in the state counselling. The state counseling reserves 85% of seats for the domicile students of Bihar under the state quota. The students from other states/non-domicile students can apply to Ayush colleges in Bihar only through the 15% of seats under the All India Quota, which is managed by the AACCC .

sections.heading: Bihar Ayush Counselling Process- State Quota

content.text: The following is the detailed procedure involved in the Bihar Ayush Counselling 2025 for admission to seats under the state quota.

items: Candidates must visit the Bihar Ayush Counselling official website at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in/ and click on Apply Online through the Online Application Portal of UGMAC (Ayush)-2025.
Register for the counselling using the mobile number and email id. OTP will be sent to the email id for registration.
Provide personal and academic information and upload your photo and signature.
Make payment of the counselling fee as prescribed, and after registering successfully, download the online application form for future reference.
The merit list is published on the official website on the basis of the NEET-UG ranks.
On the basis of the merit list of eligible candidates, the choice of colleges can be filled according to the preference of the candidates. It is mandatory to lock the choices after selection.
Seats are allotted on the basis of NEET-UG scores, merit rank, reservation policy, and choice of colleges.
Candidates shall log in to the official website of BCECEB, UGMAC (Ayush) to view the result and download the allotment letter.
After seats are allotted, candidates have to report to the designated center for document verification. The original certificates and documents should be produced for verification.
The candidates must join the college allotted to them and submit the original documents to the college. Make payment of the prescribed college fees to confirm your admission.
Bihar Ayush Counselling is conducted in 4 Rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Round 3/ Stray Vacancy Round.
Vacant seats after the allotment of previous rounds are only filled through the stray vacancy round.
Registration and online choice filling shall be done once, which applies to both Round 1 & Round 2.
Fresh registration and online choice filling are required for Round 3 & Stray Vacancy Round.

sections.heading: Bihar Ayush Counselling Process- All India Quota (AIQ)

content.text: The following is the detailed procedure involved in the Bihar Ayush Counselling 2025 for admission to seats under the All India Quota, conducted by AACCC .

items: The candidates must apply online for the Bihar Ayush Counselling through the official website of AACCC at aaccc.gov.in .
Register by using your mobile number and email id and provide the necessary personal and academic information.
Make payment of the counselling fees, including the non-refundable registration fee and refundable security fees.
Upload the necessary certificates and documents.
Candidates need to fill in the choice of colleges according to their preference and lock the choices before the deadline.
Seats are allotted based on the NEET score, merit rank, reservation of seats, and the choice of colleges in multiple rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Round 3/ Stray Vacancy Round.
The eligibility and participation criteria for each round vary.
Stray Vacancy round allotment is made for vacant seats after the previous rounds.
The Allotment result is published on the official website of AACCC. Log in to the website with your credentials and download the allotment letter.
Candidates must report to the allotted college with the necessary original certificates for verification and make payment of the fees within the time prescribed by the college to confirm your seat.

Bihar Ayush Counselling Process- State Quota

The following is the detailed procedure involved in the Bihar Ayush Counselling 2025 for admission to seats under the state quota.

Registration

Candidates must visit the Bihar Ayush Counselling official website at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in/ and click on Apply Online through the Online Application Portal of UGMAC (Ayush)-2025.

Register for the counselling using the mobile number and email id. OTP will be sent to the email id for registration.

Provide personal and academic information and upload your photo and signature.

Make payment of the counselling fee as prescribed, and after registering successfully, download the online application form for future reference.

Publication of Merit List

The merit list is published on the official website on the basis of the NEET-UG ranks.

Choice Filling

On the basis of the merit list of eligible candidates, the choice of colleges can be filled according to the preference of the candidates. It is mandatory to lock the choices after selection.

Seat Allotment

Seats are allotted on the basis of NEET-UG scores, merit rank, reservation policy, and choice of colleges.

Candidates shall log in to the official website of BCECEB, UGMAC (Ayush) to view the result and download the allotment letter.

Document Verification

After seats are allotted, candidates have to report to the designated center for document verification. The original certificates and documents should be produced for verification.

Reporting to Allotted College

The candidates must join the college allotted to them and submit the original documents to the college. Make payment of the prescribed college fees to confirm your admission.

Important Points to Note

Bihar Ayush Counselling is conducted in 4 Rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Round 3/ Stray Vacancy Round.

Vacant seats after the allotment of previous rounds are only filled through the stray vacancy round.

Registration and online choice filling shall be done once, which applies to both Round 1 & Round 2.

Fresh registration and online choice filling are required for Round 3 & Stray Vacancy Round.

Bihar Ayush Counselling Process- All India Quota (AIQ)

Registration & Fee Payment

The candidates must apply online for the Bihar Ayush Counselling through the official website of AACCC at aaccc.gov.in .

Register by using your mobile number and email id and provide the necessary personal and academic information.

Make payment of the counselling fees, including the non-refundable registration fee and refundable security fees.

Upload the necessary certificates and documents.

Choice Filling/Locking

Candidates need to fill in the choice of colleges according to their preference and lock the choices before the deadline.

Seat Allotment

Seats are allotted based on the NEET score, merit rank, reservation of seats, and the choice of colleges in multiple rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Round 3/ Stray Vacancy Round.

The eligibility and participation criteria for each round vary.

Stray Vacancy round allotment is made for vacant seats after the previous rounds.

Allotment Result Publication

The Allotment result is published on the official website of AACCC. Log in to the website with your credentials and download the allotment letter.

Physical Reporting to College

Candidates must report to the allotted college with the necessary original certificates for verification and make payment of the fees within the time prescribed by the college to confirm your seat.
